jobPosting.title: Site Reliability Engineer, New Grad
jobPosting.descriptionHtml:
This posting is unlisted and reachable only by direct link.

What you will do

  • Operate Kubernetes clusters across three regions
  • Own the on-call rotation runbooks and incident reviews
  • Write automation in Go and Python

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree completed by mid 2027
  • Linux fundamentals and networking basics
  • Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
